title: MySportWeb
description: The backend of MySportWeb: requests, uploads, thumbnails, backups, database and process. From monitoring/grafana in the repository of the backend.

panels.title: Up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus reaches the metrics of the backend.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: The version of the backend (MSW_TAG).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Since the last start of the backend.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: Age of the last successful dump of the backup service. Red past 26 hours (the MySportWebBackupTooOld alert). Empty: BACKUP_DIR unreadable or not mounted.

panels.title: Schema
panels.description: The version of the schema of the database (its last migration).

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Counted at most once a minute.

panels.title: Activities
panels.description: Of all the users, counted at most once a minute.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Per second, over the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: 5xx
panels.description: Share of the requests failing with a server error over the last hour.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: 4xx: refused requests (expired session, a wrong id...), 5xx: server errors.

panels.title: Latency of the reads
panels.description: GET requests only: the uploads take seconds by design (analysis, thumbnail).

panels.title: Server errors by route
panels.description: The routes answering 5xx: their errors are in the logs of the backend.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile of the time to answer, by route.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(mysportweb_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Analyses
panels.description: FIT files analysed (uploads, trims, recomputes, backfills). error: unreadable file; busy: refused, every slot taken for a minute (503).

panels.title: Analysis duration
panels.description: The wait for a slot excluded.

panels.title: Slots in use
panels.description: The heavy work runs a few at a time; at capacity, the next requests wait up to a minute, then are refused.

panels.title: Thumbnails
panels.description: Thumbnails drawn: uploads, trims, and their redraw at the start.

panels.title: Thumbnail duration
panels.description: The download of the missing map tiles included.

panels.title: Map tiles
panels.description: cache: from MEDIA/tiles; download: from the tile server (MAP_TILE_URL); stale: download failed, an expired tile used; error: none (the thumbnail has a hole).

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: failure: wrong username or password; locked: too many failures for the username. Many failures: someone guessing passwords.

panels.title: Backfills running
panels.description: The backfill steps of the start: long ones after an upgrade (analysing the activities again, drawing the thumbnails again).

panels.title: Backfill last duration
panels.description: How long each step of the last start took.

panels.title: Backfill remaining
panels.description: What each backfill step of the start has left: activities, or segments for the re-match of the segments. Empty when no step has work left.

panels.title: Segment matching
panels.description: Activities matched with a segment, and the passes found, by trigger: create (a new segment), upload, trim, backfill (segments matched again with new rules), reanalysis (activities analysed again by a new engine).

panels.title: Segment match duration
panels.description: Time to match an activity with a segment, its reading excluded.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: The connection pool of the backend to the database, 100 connections at most (go_sql_max_open_connections).

panels.title: Waiting for a connection
panels.description: Time the requests spent waiting for a free connection: above 0, the pool is exhausted (slow queries).

panels.title: Backup size
panels.description: Size of the most recent dump: a sudden drop is worth a look.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Of the backend; the analyses and the backfills are the heaviest.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: A FIT file is decoded whole: the analyses use the most.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Steadily growing: something never ends (a leak).

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: Connections and files of the backend; near process_max_fds, new connections fail.
